{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
print(total_revenue_by_channel)

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.loc[total_revenue_by_channel['revenue'].idxmax(), 'channel']
print(f"Channel with highest total revenue: {best_channel}")"}
